public.label: Anyone with the link
public.summary: Opens for anyone who has the link.

email_capture.label: Anyone with a verified email
email_capture.summary: Anyone can open it after confirming an email. You’ll see who.
email_capture.if_forwarded: Opens once they confirm their own email.
email_capture.they_will: Enter a code from their email.

email_domain.label: Work or school email
email_domain.summary: Only email addresses at a domain you choose, like studio.com.
email_domain.if_forwarded: Opens only with an email at your domain.
email_domain.they_will: Enter a code from their work or school email.

invite_only.label: People you invite
invite_only.summary: Only the email addresses you add. Forwarded links won’t open.
invite_only.they_will: Confirm the invited email with a code.

review.label: People you approve
review.summary: Anyone can ask. Only people you approve get in.
review.if_forwarded: They can ask. It stays closed until you approve.
review.they_will: Confirm their email, then wait for you.
review.you_will_see: Each request, before anyone gets in.

keys.label: Devices you approve
keys.summary: Only passkeys and devices you approve. Forwarded links won’t open.
keys.they_will: Create a passkey and send you its approval code.

contract.label: Custom access
contract.summary: Your app or service decides who gets in.
